rule: every Worker heap sample (Runtime.getHeapUsage usedSize after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage, every 60 s from the steady start) from minute 5 to the last lies within 2 MiB (2097152 bytes) of the minute-5 sample (testing.md section 5)
noEgressLayer: no packet egress (netguard counters, from BitGauge's start to the end of the run)
verdict: pass: minutes 5 to 6 within 2097152 bytes of the minute-5 sample (largest 0)
environmentalLimits: tc shaping jitter (tbf burst sizes, netem timer granularity).
Docker bridge overhead at high rates.
Playwright WebKit ≠ Safari: Worker XHR and nextHopProtocol behavior must be re-checked on real Safari.
Mobile power management: device runs happen with the screen on.
cannotProve: What the harness cannot prove: real Wi-Fi behavior, real VPN MTU effects, carrier-grade NAT, and anything about networks the project does not target.
